questions.markdown:
A Germanium diode has a saturation current of 1 pA at $27^0C$. Determine

(a) Diode bias voltage when diode current is $3\,\text{mA}$

(b) Diode bias current when the temperature changes to $340\,\text{K}$, for the same bias voltage.

(c) Also determine the dynamic resistance of the diode at this new temperature.

Clearly show all calculation steps

Determine the value of $W/L$ in figure that places $M_1$ at the edge of saturation. Also, calculate the drain voltage change for a $1$-mV change at the gate. Assume $\mu_n C_{ox} = 100\,\mu\text{A}/\text{V}^2$ and $V_{TH} = 0.2\,\text{V}$

questions.markdown: Explain the term Peak Inverse Voltage (PIV). How does it affect the selection of diodes in a full-wave and bridge rectifier circuit?

A sinusoidal voltage with $20$-0-$20\,\text{V}$ applied to secondary of the transformer used for full wave rectification. If the load resistance is $1\,\text{k}\Omega$, determine:

(a) Peak value of load current

(b) Average load current

(c) RMS load current

(d) Average output voltage

(e) Rms output voltage

(f) Efficiency

(g) Ripple factor

(h) PIV

questions.markdown: Design a Zener regulator network with $R_S = 500\,\Omega$, $V_Z = 12\,\text{V}$ and $V_i = 50\,\text{V}$. Determine the minimum and maximum values of $R_L$ and load current so that Zener diode remains in ON state and safe, given that $I_{ZK} = 2\,\text{mA}$ and $P_{ZM} = 500\,\text{mW}$. Draw the circuit diagram for the same.

Determine CMRR in dB for an OPAMP, if we obtain an output voltage of $5\,\text{V}$ for input voltages of $V_1 = 0.5\,\text{mV}$ and $V_2 = -0.5\,\text{mV}$ applied to non-inverting and inverting terminals respectively, and $10\,\text{mV}$ if both inputs $V_1$ and $V_2$ are $0.5\,\text{mV}$.

Draw the circuit diagram of Op-Amp inverting summing amplifier with $V_1$, $V_2$ as the input voltages and derive the expression for output voltage. Also design the circuit using two Op-Amp's to obtain, $V_{out} = 6V_1 + 0.2V_2 + 4V_3$ where $V_1$, $V_2$, and $V_3$ are input voltages. Assume $R_F = 10\,\text{k}\Omega$.

a. Encode the data bits $1111$ into 7 bit even parity Hamming code.

b. Identify the corrupted position in the transmitted code $1101111$ based on $(7,4)$ even parity Hamming code.

c. Modify the corrupted position and decode the correct data.

Implement a full adder using minimum number of logic gates. Assume $A,B$ and $C_{in}$ are inputs whereas Sum and Carry are outputs. Obtain the Boolean expression for sum and carry using the truth table.

Obtain the minimal sum of product expressions based on the sum of minterms given below using K-map and implement it using NAND gate.

$$
F(A,B,C,D)=\Sigma m(0,2,4,8,10,12)+d(6,7,13,14)
$$
Design a 3 bit Ripple down counter using negative edge triggered T flipflops and draw the output waveforms showing all the possible states of the counter.

Consider a serial input data $10100110$ fed to a 4-bit shift register circuit from LSB. Determine the output for SISO operation after 5th clock pulse and the number of clock pulses required to shift MSB bit to the output. Also, draw the circuit diagram.
Given an FM signal $V_{FM}(t)=20\cos\left[2\Pi 10^8 t + 5\sin(2\Pi 25000 t)\right]$, Calculate carrier frequency, modulating frequency, frequency deviation and bandwidth using Carson's rule.
Draw the block diagram of basic communication System and explain the function of each block.
